prompt: Rewrite this engineering procedure with the engineering-default SEE profile. Source: To diagnose access problems, authenticate the account, authorize it, and check that it looks good. Respond with exactly three newline-separated fields: PROFILE: strict|engineering-default; REWRITE: <one line>; AMBIGUITIES: <text or none>.
